existingGameplayIdPolicy: All actual IDs/enums remain null until verified in Unity project. Preserve existing gameplay mapping/footprints/colliders.
headingConvention: E right, N away/up with genuine back view, W left, S front/down. No entire billboard rotations.
puppetHeadingPolicy: heading and lookHeading mean LOOK TOWARD PLAYER. displacementHeading is the OPPOSITE retreat vector, NOT lookHeading.
worldMotionPolicy: Sprites are contact-anchored poses only. Authoritative existing tween moves the world root. Pedestal pixels and logical pivot remain stationary in each local frame.
